items.t: How Much Does a 60-Year-Old Need Invested to Replace a $125,000 Salary With Dividends and Never Sell a Share?
items.sum: One rule, never sell a share, sounds bulletproof until you check what happened to these six high-yield holdings this year. One dividend was slashed, another switched its payment schedule, and a few funds shrank even as they kept paying.

items.sum: REITs could beat the S&P 500: cheap valuations, strong balance sheets, M&A upside, and durable sector growth. Click here to read more on the REITs.

items.t: How Much Do You Need in a Roth IRA at 58 to Replace a $120,000 Salary Tax-Free?
items.sum: Quitting at 58 sounds simple when your savings sit in a Roth. But one hidden clock, and the wrong conversion pulled at the wrong time, can turn tax-free money into a penalty bill. Find out which dates to check before you walk out.
